expression: grel:with(value.trim().toUppercase(), v, if(or(v == "FR", v == "FRA", v == "FRANCE"), "FR", if(or(v == "DE", v == "DEU", v == "GERMANY", v == "ALLEMAGNE"), "DE", if(or(v == "ES", v == "ESP", v == "ESPAÑA", v == "ESPAGNE", v == "SPAIN"), "ES", if(or(v == "BE", v == "BEL", v == "BELGIQUE", v == "BELGIUM"), "BE", null)))))
description: Transformer le texte sur les cellules de la colonne country à laide de lexpression grel:with(value.trim().toUppercase(), v, if(or(v == "FR", v == "FRA", v == "FRANCE"), "FR", if(or(v == "DE", v == "DEU", v == "GERMANY", v == "ALLEMAGNE"), "DE", if(or(v == "ES", v == "ESP", v == "ESPAÑA", v == "ESPAGNE", v == "SPAIN"), "ES", if(or(v == "BE", v == "BEL", v == "BELGIQUE", v == "BELGIUM"), "BE", null)))))

Transformer le texte sur les cellules de la colonne birth_date à laide de lexpression grel:value.toString().trim().toDate("yyyy-MM-dd", "dd/MM/yyyy", "yyyy/MM/dd", "dd-MM-yyyy").toString("yyyy-MM-dd")

expression: grel:if(and(cells.get("country").value == "FR", isNonBlank(value)), with("00000" + value.toString().trim(), s, s.substring(s.length() - 5)), value)
description: Transformer le texte sur les cellules de la colonne postal_code à laide de lexpression grel:if(and(cells.get("country").value == "FR", isNonBlank(value)), with("00000" + value.toString().trim(), s, s.substring(s.length() - 5)), value)

expression: grel:with(value.toString().replace(/[\s.\-]/, ""), p, if(p.startsWith("0033"), "+33" + p.substring(4), if(p.startsWith("00"), "+" + p.substring(2), if(and(p.length() == 10, p.startsWith("0")), "+33" + p.substring(1), p))))
